$comment: The machine-readable IAMAI brand system (task 029). Every value the owner approved is written here exactly once, as a value rather than as prose: a later pack reads this file instead of re-reading a paragraph and guessing. src/brand/brand.test.ts holds the repository to it — the palette, the null tagline, the logo family and version, the asset paths, the forbidden SVG constructs and the four application-design hashes. The human record is docs/brand/iamai-brand-contract.md and the visual reference is docs/brand/iamai-brand-system.html; where a value and a sentence disagree, this file is the value.

brand.name: IAMAI
brand.taglineNote: There is no tagline. The exploratory lines produced while generating brand concepts (PLAN PROGRESS ACHIEVE, FROM HERE TO WHAT'S NEXT, IDENTITY ROADMAP, PLAN WITH EVIDENCE, GUIDED PROGRESSION, PEOPLE + AI + A BRIGHTER TOMORROW) are not approved copy and must not be baked into a logo asset. A descriptor joins the lockup only when a later task approves it as product or marketing copy.

logo.familyNote: Version 1 was Guided Route — Variant 2, a rounded window with a route through it. The owner replaced it with Threshold: two equal-width doorway panels forming an open threshold. The version moves because the mark changed family, which is the rule the previous version's record set. The geometry authority is docs/design/approved/reference/iamai-threshold-master.svg and the master below is a byte-for-byte copy of it.

wordmark.compositionNote: The lockup is composed at use: the mark asset beside the live text IAMAI in the locally loaded IBM Plex Sans. There is no canonical exported lockup carrying <text>, because such a file renders in the wrong face wherever the font is not installed.

topology: two flat filled panels and nothing else
equal panel widths, 31 units each, on the 100 grid
an opening 38 units wide between inner edges x31 and x69
the left panel sloping toward the opening, from y22 at the outer edge to y30 at the inner
the right panel's five points, whose x35,y30 lintel tip is the leftward overhang above the opening
a tall outer rise on the right, from y0 at the outer edge down to the outer bottoms at y100

geometry.$comment: The exact approved measurements. Prose loses; the SVG and these values win. The right panel is FIVE points: removing x35,y30, or starting the polygon at x69,y30, destroys the approved mark.

masterRules.titleAndDescNote: The approved master carries a <title> and a <desc>: they name the mark for anyone who opens the file, and they are not a wordmark or a tagline. scripts/brandDerive.ts strips them from the geometry the interface draws, because that mark is aria-hidden beside the live wordmark.

derivation.$comment: Only the master is drawn by hand. Every other asset is written from it by the script, and the test re-derives and compares.
derivation.rasterNote: public/brand/favicon-32.png is Chrome drawing public/brand/favicon.svg at 32px. The SVG is the authority; the test asserts the PNG's dimensions, not its bytes.

deferredPlatformAssets.$comment: Not produced. Nothing in the site references them today, and an unreferenced icon is a file nobody maintains. A pack that adds a web app manifest or an Apple touch icon derives them from the same master.

semantics.$comment: Brand and state are different questions. brandPrimary answers 'this is IAMAI, this is selected, this is the action'; success answers 'the tenant is in a good state'. A surface that paints a brand action in the success colour tells the reader something untrue about their tenant.

stateRoles.attention: needs a decision, a date or a check
stateRoles.danger: would break something, or is blocked

roles.role: technical / identifier / JSON / PowerShell / Graph path

typography.appliedNote: Task 030 wired the three families and the interface scale, and added the display ramp read out of the four approved packs (src/ui/tokens.ts DISPLAY). Its correction staged IBM Plex Serif SemiBold and Bold and normalised the Serif family onto @ibm/plex-serif@1.1.0, so every role weight above is set in a real face: ROLE_WEIGHTS.display is the approved 700, not a browser-synthesised fake bold. src/ui/tokens.test.ts fails if a role's weight has no staged face. Composing a page was left to the restoration packs: at task 030 the sizes production set were the interface scale alone, and a surface expressed the display ramp only once its own pack restored it. Packs 031-040 did that for every surface, and `production.pageCompositionRestored` below is where that fact is recorded — this note is task 030's history and does not hold a second copy of it.

ui.radiusNote: A hierarchy, not a licence to cardify every section. Task 030 replaced production's single 4px token with these three (src/ui/tokens.ts LAYOUT.radiusPx / radiusControlPx / radiusPanelPx), and src/ui/design-lint.test.ts rule 3 now admits a radius only through one of them.
ui.texture: evidence grid, marketing and brand surfaces only, never behind dense operational data

voice.$comment: A guardrail for later copy, not a licence to rewrite accurate production content. docs/design/content.json remains the copy authority.
is: confident only where evidence supports it

applicationDesignAuthority.$comment: Task 028 established these four files as the owner-approved application authorities. Brand repaints them; brand never rearranges them. The hashes are repeated here so a brand change that quietly edited a pack fails this task's test as well as 028's.
brandMayChange: type family within an approved role
radius and surface treatment where compatible

generatedBrandApplicationPreviews.$comment: Application-page previews produced while exploring the brand are colour and brand framing only. This block records no path, because a preview is never an authority for anything.

production.$comment: What is switched on in production. Task 029 wired the favicon; task 030 applied the palette, the type system and the shell lockup; packs 031-040 restored page-specific composition for Home, Connect, Plan and MFA Readiness onto their approved packs and converged Export, How and Inventory onto the same grammar. These flags say what LANDED. They are not a conformance certificate: docs/design/approved/manifest.json keeps `productionAssumedConformant` false for every surface, because conformance is proven per change by the two-sided anatomy tests and the rendered comparison, never assumed from a flag.
